actions.create_post.description: Creates a new post on a Canny board.
actions.create_post.props.authorID.descr: The unique identifier of the post author (Canny user ID).
actions.create_post.props.byID.descripti: The unique identifier of the admin creating the post on behalf of the author.
actions.create_post.props.categoryID.des: The unique identifier of the category to assign.
actions.create_post.props.createdAt.desc: Original creation date in ISO 8601 format, for migrating posts from another source.
actions.create_post.props.customFields.d: Custom fields as key-value pairs (keys max 30 chars, values max 200 chars).
actions.create_post.props.details.descri: The longer description of the post.
actions.create_post.props.eta.descriptio: The estimated delivery date in MM/YYYY format (e.g. "06/2026").
actions.create_post.props.etaPublic.desc: Whether the ETA should be visible to all users.
actions.create_post.props.ownerID.descri: The unique identifier of the user responsible for completing the work.
actions.create_post.props.title.descript: A brief title describing the post.
actions.create_vote.description: Casts a vote on a post on behalf of a user.
actions.create_vote.props.postID.descrip: The unique identifier of the post to vote on.
actions.create_vote.props.voterID.descri: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).
actions.delete_vote.description: Removes a vote from a post for a given user.
actions.delete_vote.props.postID.descrip: The unique identifier of the post to remove the vote from.
actions.delete_vote.props.voterID.descri: The unique identifier of the voter (Canny user ID).
actions.list_posts.description: Returns a list of posts for a board, with optional filtering and sorting.
actions.list_posts.props.boardID.descrip: The board to list posts for (optional — omit to list across all boards).
actions.list_posts.props.search.descript: A search query to filter posts.
actions.list_posts.props.skip.descriptio: Number of posts to skip (for pagination).
actions.list_posts.props.status.descript: Comma-separated list of statuses to filter by (e.g. "open,planned").
actions.retrieve_post.description: Retrieves the details of an existing post by its ID.
actions.retrieve_post.props.id.descripti: The unique identifier of the post.
auth.description: Your Canny secret API key. Find it at Settings → API in your Canny admin dashboard.
description: Product feedback management platform. Collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests from your users.
triggers.new_comment.description: Triggers when a new comment is created on a post.
triggers.new_post.description: Triggers when a new post is created on a Canny board.
triggers.new_vote.description: Triggers when a user votes on a post.
triggers.post_status_changed.description: Triggers when a post's status is changed (e.g. open → in progress → complete).
